speaker: Doctor
text: Given your recent levofloxacin use and frequent watery stools, I need to check for *C. difficile* infection. Have you had any fever or nausea, and REQUEST TEST: Stool_C_diff_toxin_assay

speaker: Doctor
text: The leukocytosis with neutrophil predominance strongly suggests an infectious etiology like *C. difficile*, especially given the recent antibiotic exposure. I will request further confirmation and assess your hydration status. REQUEST TEST: Stool_C_diff_GDH_antigen; REQUEST IMAGES

speaker: Doctor
text: It is highly unusual for all three stool tests to be unspecified, so I need to clarify your current status. Are you currently experiencing any high fever, severe abdominal distension, or signs of dehydration like dizziness?

speaker: Doctor
text: Despite the ambiguous lab results, your clinical picture of recent fluoroquinolone use, significant leukocytosis, and watery diarrhea is classic for *Clostridioides difficile* infection. speaker: Doctor
